title: Density-aware startup (spec 09 14.8): absent in C, partial in Rust, first DIO/DIS wiring unproven
description: Spec 09 14.8 boot-storm block R-09-134..139: nodes MUST implement density-aware startup - boot listen-only random uniform [LISTEN_PERIOD_MIN=30s, LISTEN_PERIOD_MAX=60s]; count unique nodes heard deduplicated by EUI-64/short address from announces/DIOs/DIS/valid frames; initial_delay = min(MAX_STARTUP_DELAY=300s, nodes_heard * DELAY_PER_NODE=5s); delay random(0, initial_delay) before first transmission; scaled delay MUST apply to first announce, first DIO, and first DIS. Classification: Python implemented+tested (python/src/lichen/timing/startup_delay.py:22-199 BootStormMitigation.observe_node dedup + compute_startup_delay_s; tests python/tests/test_startup_delay.py:100-177; first-announce wiring python/src/lichen/announce/scheduler.py:276-279); Rust partial (rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs:13-38 initial_startup_delay constants+formula+tests only - no listen period, no node-heard tracking); C/Zephyr NOT-IMPLEMENTED (no LISTEN_PERIOD*/nodes_heard/startup-delay symbols anywhere in lichen/subsys). No implementation applies the delay to first DIO or first DIS (only first announce evidenced). MAY shorten-listen-if-idle-15s also absent everywhere (MAY, not filed separately). Suggested placement: C - add boot-time listen/defer state to lichen/subsys/lichen/link before first TX; Rust - extend lichen-node boot path; both + verify first DIO/DIS deferral.
